elements.element: Cap applies mutually to both parties
elements.evidence: "The total liability for either Party, regardless of the form of action"

elements.element: Cap limb (a): fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim
elements.evidence: "the twelve (12) months immediately preceding the event giving rise to the action" — anchored to an event, not the claim

elements.element: Cap limb (b): USD 1,000,000 floor, structured as the greater of (a) and (b)
elements.evidence: "the greater of (a) ... and (b) one million U.S. dollars (US$1,000,000)"
"Neither Party will be liable to the other for lost profits, consequential, punitive, or incidental damages"

elements.element: Uncapped carve-out: breach of confidentiality obligations
elements.evidence: "a Party's breach of its confidentiality, data protection or security obligations"
"a Party's indemnification obligations under this Agreement"

elements.element: Uncapped carve-out: infringement of the other party's IP
elements.evidence: "a Party's infringement of the other Party's intellectual property rights"

elements.element: Customer's payment obligations are not "damages" for cap purposes
elements.evidence: "IBM's obligation to pay amounts properly due under this Agreement" is listed only as an Excluded Claim; no statement that payment obligations are not damages

elements.element: Fallback: mutual cap of 12 months' fees
elements.evidence: "the greater of (a) the amounts paid or payable ... and (b) one million U.S. dollars" — a greater-of cap, not a 12 months' fees cap

elements.element: Fallback carve-outs: indemnification, confidentiality, gross negligence, wilful misconduct
elements.evidence: "indemnification obligations ... confidentiality, data protection or security obligations ... gross negligence, willful misconduct or fraud"

offending_extra_words: the event giving rise to the action
This limitation does not apply to Excluded Claims, which means
by IBM to MSL under this Agreement
reasons: The fee limb is anchored to "the event giving rise to the action" rather than the claim, so it does not match the preferred formulation "fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim"; change the anchor to the claim.

Customer's payment obligations are treated only as an uncapped Excluded Claim; the preferred position also requires an express statement that Customer's payment obligations (or amounts due) are not "damages" for cap purposes.

Minimality fails: the replacement expands 43 words to 97 (ratio 2.26) with a changed-character ratio of 0.882, rewriting the whole cap sentence; a tighter operator/number edit plus a short separate carve-out insertion would suffice.

Fallback is also not literally met on its cap element (greater-of rather than 12 months' fees), so the clause does not rest safely at the fallback either; the exclusion of indirect/consequential damages and all preferred carve-outs are present.
Unrelated terms and the untouched paragraph (a) remain effective; "Excluded Claims" is defined inline, so no dangling or undefined term is introduced.
